goal: Remove repeated original and personal-state decryption from current native judgment checks while preserving actual current source, phase, owner and episode authority.
procedure: Nominate only an explicit finite exact context through actual registered governed services; sample actual metadata once within a private per-call view; retain a canonical nomination baseline and an uncached original-service fence around initial private reads without repeating the full nomination traversal; keep current scope, purpose and exact service bindings live; invoke an optional actual role qualification gate only after current source/control metadata denial checks, fence that gate again before owner/source opens, then use guarded selected ciphertext/plaintext custody to assemble and authenticate the actual context once; capture exact immutable Claim/version/evidence, active state/version/activation/rollback, source registration/raw custody/grant and accepted-episode lineage bindings; detect mutations to the retained context receipt; discard all sampled metadata before an uncached final exact fence; resolve current owner verification anew, keeping actual proof I/O behind the metadata-only barrier; retain full current accepted-episode proof reads because the existing external admission and qualification port is mutable; reject live accelerator nominations until explicitly frozen; recheck current phase authority before and after slow metadata work, uncached fences and proof reads; resolve slow accepted-episode metadata before current original/control source checks and repeat the fresh narrow source/grant fence after the final external phase callback before private ciphertext can reach decryption; leave artifact and execution qualification to the runtime's existing independent boundaries.
authority: The helper grants no permission or approval and produces no inference model. Trust begins with actual selected private assembly and independently enrolled signatures; current registered purpose permission and existing episode semantic/formation verifiers remain authoritative.
validation: Twenty-five local tests pass using real encrypted object custody and Ed25519 owner checks with explicitly controlled SQL/source/admission fixtures. Tests cover final-episode and final-phase callback withdrawal before AES construction, the initial final-phase callback preceding private qualification, qualification hook ordering and withdrawal, no ordinary repeated original/state byte replay, revoked current owner proof, replaced current owner verifier, phase withdrawal during inner owner ciphertext lookup before plaintext returns, exact Claim/state/source/rollback mutations, held context mutation, parent-source withdrawal, an allowed but different grant generation, unsupported live routes, metadata mutation during initial assembly and after a policy lookup, and actual accepted-episode admission withdrawal. In the owner-only SQL fixture each governed head/version/history row is fetched exactly twice per metadata_current call: sampled actual pass then uncached exact fence; a fresh next guard repeats both. Physical selected-engine comparison and its time/resource budget remain required.
failure_or_lesson: Repeated full runtime context reconstruction authenticates the same source/state bytes many times and dominated the prior selected native comparison budget. A metadata snapshot captured only after assembly could bless a mutation during a private read, so an initial actual nomination baseline and current pre/post inner-cipher fences are necessary. Memoization must stop at one metadata pass and never cache owner, semantic or permission decisions. Immutable accepted publication metadata does not establish current external admission authority; without a new qualified narrow port the existing full governed proof read must remain. Copying nested guarded custody wrappers required safe attribute resolution and unbound actual encrypted-plane reads so inner ciphertext withdrawal still precedes decryption.
notes: No user data, learned model artifact, fabricated native judgment or production approval was used. Controlled episode qualification/admission fixtures establish denial wiring only. Exact metadata records remain private in memory; the seed records public construction method only and stays in FloRA. This is not a linked supervised builder case, cross-plane atomic transaction, measured physical latency result or proof that the full experiment succeeds.
